column3: “Let it turn back … may you comfort” is rendered as statements, “is turned away … You comfort.”
“Yah Yahweh” is rendered “the LORD GOD,” and “might” as “song.”
“With joy” is rendered “joyously,” and NASB adds “Therefore.”
“Bring to remembrance” is rendered “Make them remember.”
“Majesty” is rendered “excellent things,” and “made known” as “Let this be known.”
